name: DGX Spark Memory Saver
description: Reduce GPU page-table memory overhead by patching NVIDIA UVM allocation on qualified 64 KiB DGX Spark kernels.
compatibility: GB10 Linux aarch64; reviewed NVIDIA open-driver profiles; manual or DKMS installation.
limitations: Changes a kernel module and initramfs; requires root access, matching headers, signing, and an explicit activation/rollback plan.
R580 has production-trial evidence; R610 has additional conditions. Check the exact driver/kernel compatibility manifest.
Distribution is source-only; build and sign locally. Remove overrides before NVIDIA upgrades and recheck compatibility.
Original additions are MIT-licensed; retained NVIDIA source and patches carry their own notices and terms.

sources.note: Documents the listed workflow, requirements, compatibility, and limitations.
